def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    groups=[]
    source_rows=set()
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        c=0; runs=[]
        while c<w:
            if row[c]==0:
                c+=1; continue
            start=c
            while c<w and row[c]!=0: c+=1
            if c-start>=4:
                runs.append((start,row[start:c]))
        if runs:
            source_rows.add(r)
            groups.extend(seq for _,seq in runs)
    memberships={v:g for g in groups for v in g}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if r in source_rows: continue
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0 or v not in memberships: continue
            seq=memberships[v]
            idx=seq.index(v)
            for offset in range(len(seq)):
                cc=c+offset-idx
                if 0<=cc<w: out[r][cc]=seq[offset]
    return out
